reason: ArenaSideNavSection renders a labelled role="group" wrapper -- its heading and aria-labelledby name the group for assistive technology -- but carries no interactive affordance of its own. Every control inside it belongs to a child component: an ArenaSideNavItem's link or button, or a nested collapsible's own trigger. Binding a control pattern here would claim an affordance that lives one level down instead. The host IS the group here, because an Angular primitive host-binds its root rather than rendering a wrapper inside it.
